rationale: Refactor refs from a flat scratchpad list into typed Evidence ledger roles. refs.md owns the shared model and safety projection; topic BPs classify their domain evidence; submission_terminal checks the completed ledger before submit.

dependencies.why: Record shape, status semantics, discount object semantics, and the 'no availability flag' rule.
Basket id, basket_status, store pointer, basket_created_at, and discount columns read by this registry.
Basket line shape (line_number, product_sku, requested_quantity) used in reconciliation.
Archived-payment semantics: older payments can carry line snapshots after basket files age out.

rollback.strategy: Retire this version to fall back to v0004, or issue a new manual_refactor version with adjusted ledger wording.

retired_reason: post-world-refresh clean competition: prevent resolver fallback to stale historical BP versions while keeping version files in place for future PA-fix history
